method.body_references: every string body scanned; counts are canonical unique source-row/matched-text/target facts from corpus-grounded cross-act aliases, versioned known-reference patterns, and an unmatched specific compound-law/regulation fallback retained verbatim; the committed nonspecific-term stoplist does not assert generic classes as instruments
method.amendment_targets: every amendment_targets key on every row scanned; counts are canonical unique source-row/target facts retained verbatim
method.projection: program frontiers remain the separately recorded relevant-root projection; the global index does not disposition or inject unrelated acts

extraction_protocol.inbound_cross_references: all pinned rows, targeted to exact spine and declared-source citations
